Refactoring complete. The original single-file implementation was split into four focused classes:

- **`LcsInput.java`** — value object wrapping the two input strings with null validation
- **`LcsResult.java`** — result object holding both the LCS length and the actual subsequence string
- **`LongestCommonSubsequence.java`** — the DP algorithm, now also backtracking to recover the actual subsequence (not just its length)
- **`LongestCommonSubsequenceApp.java`** — entry point with the example usage

Key improvements over the original: the algorithm now returns the actual LCS string (`"GTAB"`) in addition to its length, inputs are validated at construction time, and each class has a single clear responsibility.
